submitted.rationale: All EQE values on this line are very low, between 0.0002% and 0.00035%. The highest is at the most Bi-rich composition, index 0 (Sb 0.031), at 0.00035%, and EQE rises steadily toward the Bi-rich end (0.00027 → 0.0003 → 0.00035). XRD at the Bi-rich end shows a crystalline Bi2O3-type (polymorph) phase that absorbs at 2.7 eV (best match mp-23195, 0.80). At Sb 0.66, XRD shows only FTO substrate peaks, i.e. no crystalline film.

rejected.reason: Bi3SbO7 region (Sb 0.25): EQE 0.00021%, despite a predicted band gap of 2.27 eV
BiSbO4 (Sb 0.5): predicted band gap 3.06 eV is above the 2.7 eV photon energy; EQE 0.00026%
Sillenite region (Sb 0.077): EQE 0.00027%, lower than the more Bi-rich compositions
XRD shows only FTO substrate peaks (no crystalline film), so no photoactive phase is expected
